name: @stewardmd/capacitor-connect-browser
description: Native in-app browser for StewardMD Connect Hospital. The doctor signs into their hospital EMR inside a full-screen WKWebView/WebView; afterwards the Connect Agent drives the SAME web view (same cookies, same session) to discover read-only workflows. StewardMD never sees the password. iOS via this plugin package; Android is an app-target plugin (see android/app/src/main/java/in/stewardmd/app/ConnectBrowserPlugin.java).
author: StewardMD
